seo_title: How to start an online store that actually makes sales from day one
seo_description: The platform that looks cheapest upfront often isn't cheapest when you run real numbers for your specific product and volume. Here's the math that matters before you launch. Learn more on my blog. #onlinestore #ecommerce #smallbusiness
image_headline: How to start an online store that sells

pin_items.title: PLATFORM FEE MATH
pin_items.description: The monthly fee isn't the real cost - it's transaction fees, apps, and shipping math that determine whether you actually profit.

pin_items.title: SHIPPING STRATEGY FIRST
pin_items.description: Decide on free shipping built into prices, calculated rates, or flat rate before you set any product prices.

pin_items.title: PRODUCT PAGES THAT CONVERT
pin_items.description: 5-6 images per product, descriptions that handle objections, and bullet points with exact specs reduce hesitation.

pin_items.title: EMAIL CAPTURE DAY ONE
pin_items.description: Your first visitors probably won't buy - but a simple 10% off pop-up means you can market to them again.

seo_title: Why your online store gets traffic but no sales and how to fix it
seo_description: Beautiful photos and a clean theme but zero conversions? The problem is almost never the design - it's product pages that don't answer objections and shipping costs that surprise at checkout. The full breakdown is on my blog - go check it out. #ecommercetips #onlineselling
image_headline: Traffic but no sales? here's why
cta: The full breakdown is on my blog - go check it out.

pin_items.title: CHECKOUT SURPRISE
pin_items.description: Customers abandon carts when shipping costs appear unexpectedly - build shipping into your prices or set clear expectations early.

pin_items.title: WEAK PRODUCT PAGES
pin_items.description: Most descriptions list features when they should address the objections running through your customer's mind.

pin_items.title: MOBILE FRICTION
pin_items.description: Over 60% of traffic comes from phones - if buttons aren't thumb-sized and checkout has too many steps, you're losing sales.

pin_items.title: NO EMAIL CAPTURE
pin_items.description: Without collecting emails, you're paying to acquire each visitor once and never seeing most of them again.

seo_description: Week 1: foundation and legal setup. Week 2: platform and shipping. Week 3: product pages. Week 4: testing and launch. This is the order that actually works. Get more info on my blog. #startonlinestore #ecommerce #smallbusinesstips

pin_items.title: WEEK 1: FOUNDATION
pin_items.description: Calculate true product costs, set prices with real margins, get your ein, and grab your domain name.

pin_items.title: WEEK 2: PLATFORM
pin_items.description: Connect your domain, set up payments, configure shipping zones and rates, add email capture.

pin_items.title: WEEK 3: PRODUCTS
pin_items.description: Upload 4-6 photos per product, write objection-handling descriptions, add spec bullet points.

pin_items.title: WEEK 4: LAUNCH
pin_items.description: Add legal pages, test full checkout on your actual phone, announce to your list, and open for business.

seo_title: Shopify vs square vs amazon - which platform actually costs less for your store
seo_description: Everyone compares monthly fees but skips the transaction fee math. Here's what 200 sales actually costs you on each platform - the numbers might surprise you. #shopify #ecommerceplatform #onlinestore
image_headline: The real cost of each platform

pin_items.title: SHOPIFY BASIC
pin_items.description: $39/month plus 2.9% + $0.30 per sale - on 200 orders at $32 each, you're paying about $285/month total.

pin_items.title: SQUARE ONLINE FREE
pin_items.description: No monthly fee but same transaction rates - you save $39 but lose abandoned cart recovery and advanced shipping.

pin_items.title: AMAZON SELLER
pin_items.description: $39.99/month plus 8-15% referral fees - that $32 product costs you $4.80 per sale, crushing your margins.

pin_items.title: WOOCOMMERCE 'FREE'
pin_items.description: The plugin costs nothing but hosting, security, and extensions easily reach $150-200/month for a functional store.

seo_title: From zero to selling - the online store setup most guides skip
seo_description: Stop obsessing over branding before you have products listed. The sequence that matters: platform math, shipping strategy, converting product pages, then launch before you feel ready. Get in touch to learn more. #howtostartanonlinestore #ecommercebusiness
cta: Get in touch to learn more.

pin_items.title: KNOW YOUR NUMBERS
pin_items.description: Calculate cost of goods plus packaging plus shipping, then divide by 0.5 for minimum price with 50% margins.

pin_items.title: DIMENSIONAL WEIGHT TRAP
pin_items.description: A 1 lb pillow in a large box ships as 17 lbs - if you didn't account for this, you're losing money on every sale.

pin_items.title: HELD FUNDS REALITY
pin_items.description: New stores have 20-30% of funds held for 90+ days - plan cash flow around money you've earned but can't access yet.

pin_items.title: DONE BEATS PERFECT
pin_items.description: Launch with 15 products and phone photos - you learn more from 10 real sales than 10 weeks tweaking your about page.
